sources.topic: SET_TSK_NAME input names, calling-task selection and status output

implementation.names: Case-insensitive ASCII binding names, 1..254 characters; empty source old_name selects the uniquely registered caller root including FROM-linked routines
implementation.identity: Rename in place without changing numeric task order, Program/source/module identity, namespaces, globals, linkage or execution state
implementation.scheduler: Move attribute/waiting/error keys, retain delay deadlines, and update the current round's names so self/other rename neither duplicates nor loses a turn
implementation.statuses: 0 success/no-op; 1 unknown old name; 2 invalid new name/collision; 3 missing/ambiguous caller or foreign active scheduler ownership
implementation.preflight: Check inputs, output reference and all destination keys before renaming; nonzero status leaves registry state unchanged
implementation.persistence: Live task bindings and continuations remain excluded from JSON value snapshots

portable_choices: Only the empty string selects self; space-containing names are literal
Explicit aliases are independent; ambiguous empty self lookup is rejected
Host rename APIs return portable statuses and have no implicit caller
Ready, active, paused, waiting and terminal task bindings can be renamed
Status values, name bounds and stable numeric numbering are offline contracts
unresolved: Native task name limits, identifier rules, alias behavior and error numbers
Native scheduling, group locks, task IDs, interrupts and controller execution
Strict mode and persistence of suspended execution
